name: Flowerton
source:
Welcome to Flowerton!

A whimsical, fictional Duchy set in Alternative Regency Era Britain. You know the drill - grand balls, fabulous dresses, and most importantly - romance and drama! And this is the most important ball of the year - the one where the Rose of the Season will be chosen. And that's where our protagonist comes in!

Bridget isn't your run-of-the-mill lady of the ton, no. Instead of embroidery, she prefers archery; instead of the harp, she prefers fencing. And well - those aren't the most desirable skills in the marriage market. Her mother pulled all the strings so that she could start in the competition for the title of the Rose of the Season a second time, and also pushes her to find a suitable husband. What will happen? Well, her fate is in your hands!

[From [url=https://flowerton.itch.io/flowerton-act-i]itch.io[/url]]
